question: def(W(3,5)) = fewest lines missed by a 26-set (ovoid size q^2+1)

lowerBound.argument: deficiencies 1-4 excluded by the 2q eigenfunction support bound; deficiency 5 would have to be a punctured-pencil dipole, and Holotrade commit a41a53f proved the representative dipole infeasible with flag transitivity covering all representatives

annealing.reading: 60 independent guided-annealing runs never beat 12. That is EVIDENCE that def(5) = 12, not proof: local search is not a decision procedure and has missed optima before in this repository.

defEqualsQ.why: the proved lower bound is 6, so def(5) > q

thetaMinusAlpha.why: 8 lies inside [6,12]; the exact test at 8 returned UNKNOWN

whatDefQEqualsQReallyIs: the support bound gives def(q) >= q, tight at q=3 where the dipole attains it and provably not tight at q=5. So 'def(q) = q' was the LOWER BOUND being tight at q=3, never the value.
boundary: def(5) is not determined here. The annealing floor is reported as evidence and is explicitly not a claim; all three exact tests are UNKNOWN.
